$comment: The public contract. Every look must define every name here. Names may be added in a minor release; removing or renaming one is a major release (see VERSIONING.md). CSS custom property = --bs-<name>.

color.bg-subtle: Wells: code blocks, table heads, hovered rows, inset areas.
color.bg-inverse: Inverted band: title slides, tooltips, one emphasised block per view.
color.fg-subtle: Tertiary text: dates, labels, captions, axis labels. Still >= 4.5:1.
color.line: Hairline separators. Decorative, may be low contrast.
color.line-strong: Lines that carry meaning: control borders, chart frames, heavy section rules. >= 3:1.
color.accent: The single accent: links, current item, focus, the one primary action.
color.positive: Success or gain in UI state (not chart series).
color.negative: Error or loss in UI state.
color.viz-1: Categorical series 1. Series 1-4 are >= 3:1 on bg and stay apart under protan/deutan simulation.
color.viz-5: Categorical series 5. Label directly; may be lower contrast.
color.viz-6: Categorical series 6. Label directly; may be lower contrast.
color.viz-up: Rising value / bullish candle. Pair with a shape or sign, never colour alone.
color.viz-muted: Context series: benchmark, previous period, unselected.

font.font-ui: Interface: navigation, labels, buttons, metadata, tables.
font.font-mono: Code, tabular data, measurements. Never as a costume for 'technical'.

size.size-2xs: Smallest legal label (chart ticks, footnote marks).
size.size-2xl: h1 in articles, slide titles at small scale.

type.label-case: text-transform of small labels (none or uppercase).

shape.radius-control: Corner radius of buttons and inputs.

motion.ease-out: Default easing for entering and responding.
motion.ease-in-out: Easing for moves between two states.

media.slide-title: Slide title size in design pixels.
media.slide-lead: Slide lead size in design pixels.
media.slide-body: Slide body size in design pixels.
media.slide-small: Slide small text size in design pixels.
media.slide-foot: Slide footer size in design pixels.
media.video-action-safe: Action-safe margin as a fraction of the frame (EBU R95: 0.035).
media.video-title-safe: Title-safe margin as a fraction of the frame (EBU R95: 0.05).
